model_settings.value: Feature maps were normalized to equal average sum-of-squares and combined across gray-matter density, FA, AD, MD, and RD. PCA reduced each feature to 12 components based on the minimum description length criterion; Infomax decomposed the reduced matrix into independent component images and subject-specific mixing coefficients. The jICA was repeated 50 times in Icasso, and components were clustered for stability.

software.value: Fusion ICA Toolbox (FIT) v2.0c; Infomax algorithm; Icasso for 50 repeated decompositions and clustering.

spans.text: a smoothing kernel of 8 mm (FWHM) was applied

description.value: T1-weighted images were bias-field corrected, spatially normalized with DARTEL, segmented into gray matter, white matter, and cerebrospinal fluid using SPM12/CAT12, left unmodulated to represent gray-matter density, and smoothed with an 8 mm FWHM kernel. DTI data were corrected for eddy-current distortions and motion, skull-stripped, fitted to generate FA, MD, RD, and AD maps, nonlinearly registered and skeletonized using TBSS with a mean-FA skeleton threshold of 0.20, and projected onto the skeleton. The resulting gray-matter and DTI feature maps were entered into joint ICA.
